svg.title: Changing an object or assigning a name
svg.desc: Two panels, each with an upper gray box for the module's names and a lower one for the call's names. Tag 1, inside clip_in_place: the names ranges_m and scan both have arrows to one list, [2.5, 12.0, 3.1]. Tag 2, inside clip_rebind after scan is assigned: ranges_m has an arrow to the list [2.5, 14.0, 3.1], and scan has an arrow to a new list, [2.5, 12.0, 3.1].
